Does on-hand cover it?

Decide the whole route. On-hand plus on-order against the demand, and nothing announces the answer.

  • YES, and no planned order is generated ➔ Release Sales Order Lines to Warehousing
  • NO ➔ Planning data exists
  • I don't know ➔ Inventory 360
  • Direct delivery
  • Cross-docking

Stock promised to other orders

Decide silently how much of on-hand is free for this order, which is the available-to-promise check. The figure decision 2 really tests is projected inventory, time-phased, not the on-hand total — Item Order Plan §2.1. Not documented for this release.
